rules.description: Repository must declare a specific entity — no generic multi-entity repositories
ORM choice must be declared and must be one of: prisma, drizzle, knex, typeorm
Mutating methods (write, delete) must have typed returns — void is not allowed
Repository must not import HTTP framework types (express, fastify, Request, Response)
Repository must not make external network calls (fetch, axios, http.request)
Paginated reads must include stable ordering
Raw SQL must be marked with @raw-sql-ok: reason escape hatch comment
